description: This file defines UI styling components and design tokens for an iOS app, matching Android reference screenshots. It includes color themes, view helpers, custom styles for cards, text fields, buttons, and layout constants.

classes.description: A styled container view with padding, background, border, and corner radius.

classes.description: Button style for small chip buttons with border and fill.
